mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.activity_id, a.club_id, c.club_name, a.activity_name, a.start_time, a.end_time, r.registration_time, a.status AS activity_status, r.status AS registration_status FROM registrations r JOIN activities a ON a.id = r.activity_id LEFT JOIN clubs c ON c.id = a.club_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.registration_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT at.id, at.club_id, c.club_name, at.activity_id, act.activity_name, at.attendance_type, at.attendance_time, at.remark FROM attendances at JOIN members m ON m.id = at.member_id LEFT JOIN clubs c ON c.id = at.club_id LEFT JOIN activities act ON act.id = at.activity_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY at.attendance_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.id, e.activity_id, act.activity_name, c.club_name, e.rating, e.comment, e.created_time FROM evaluations e JOIN activities act ON act.id = e.activity_id LEFT JOIN clubs c ON c.id = act.club_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT club_id) FROM members WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1) AS joined_club_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM registrations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1) AS registration_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sign_ins WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS sign_in_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM evaluations WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS evaluation_count, (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM evaluations WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS average_rating, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM attendances at JOIN members m ON at.member_id = m.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}) AS attendance_count
